messages:
Jordan (support): FYI incoming escalation from ACME corp — they say a tiny template tweak broke the output after last rollout. customer says: previously OK, now model returns unrelated instructions. high severity for them, billing is high so they're threatening to pause. :worried:
Alex M: can you paste the exact prompt change and the API call?
Jordan (support): pasted below. customer swapped a variable interpolation from \u201c{{user_name}}\u201d to \u201c{{ user_name }}\u201d (extra spaces). before: expected single-line confirmation; after: long assistant ramble with invented steps. they included curl repro: 
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXX\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"model":"rw-infer/llama-13b-opt-v3","input":"Confirm order for {{user_name}}.","max_tokens":60}'\n```
and with the minor spacing change: 
```\n-d '{"model":"rw-infer/llama-13b-opt-v3","input":"Confirm order for {{ user_name }}.","max_tokens":60}'\n```
they attached expected/actual: expected: \"Confirmed: order for Alice.\" actual: \"Here are steps to check your account and three unrelated suggestions...\"
Jordan (support): customer says this started right after deploy id v2026.03.11-prod (rolled 03/11).
Priya S: interesting. spacing in templates shouldn't affect semantics. suspect either tokenizer change or new kernel selection that mishandles braces/whitespace. any rollout notes?
deploy-bot: deployment v2026.03.11-prod -> rw-infer/llama-13b-opt-v3 (rev r4f2b) rolled at 2026-03-11T03:12:08Z :rocket:
SRE Bot: logs (filtered) show no 5xx spikes.  p95 latency +12% around rollout window. kernel_selector switched to \"fast-quant-fused\" for that model on gpu-pool-3 at 03:14Z.
Alex M: ok reproduce attempt from my laptop now. using same model + payload: 
```\nPOST /v1/generate\n{\n  \"model\": \"rw-infer/llama-13b-opt-v3\",\n  \"input\": \"Confirm order for {{ user_name }}.\",\n  \"max_tokens\": 60\n}\n```
Response: 
```\n{\n  \"id\":\"resp_abc\",\n  \"output\":\"Confirmed: order for Alice.\"\n}\n```
Alex M: hmm I got expected output locally on hosted — trying via the customer's region (eu-west-1) next.
Jordan (support): customer repro was in eu-west-1 and on Dedicated (dedicated-671). they said they've pinned model name but not revision. maybe rollout changed revision mapping.
Kai (oncall): @Priya @Alex thoughts: small template whitespace leading to different tokenization is plausible if we switched tokenizer patch or quantization that affects BPE boundary when braces adjacent to letters. check tokenizer build ID and model revision mapping.
Priya S: checking model metadata: rw-infer/llama-13b-opt-v3@rev:r4f2b (current) and previous rev r3d9a had tokenizer build 2026-02-28. r4f2b uses tokenizer 2026-03-06 which includes a micro-bpe change to collapse internal whitespace. that could change how `{{ user_name }}` tokenizes.
SRE Bot: quick grep in logs for customer request id shows their requests were routed to node gpu-3a with kernel fast-quant-fused and model rev r4f2b. No errors, but assistant outputs show much higher entropy (topk/top_p config unchanged).
Jordan (support): customer also reports minor latency increase and one billing anomaly (token counts for same prompt jumped by ~7%). they attached billing screenshot.
Alex M: token count change + output difference = tokenizer delta. likely cause. two mitigation paths: 1) pin customers to previous model revision (r3d9a) until we confirm, or 2) deploy a rolling fix that restores previous tokenizer behavior.
Priya S: agree. immediate mitigation: create per-customer routing rule to map dedicated-671 to rev r3d9a. I'll prepare a roll-forward patch once we validate with regression suites.
Kai (oncall): can we run a quick regression eval across our standard prompt set plus the customer's template? if it fails, hot rollback. I can spin up canary with r3d9a and run tests in eu-west-1.
Jordan (support): customer asked for ETA within 2 hours. they're on the phone with support.
Alex M: recreating exact customer environment now (dedicated config + region). Sharing commands in thread.
Alex M: repro steps: 1) hit dedicated endpoint with customer's API key 2) run both variants of template 3) compare outputs and token counts. sample script: 
```bash
for t in \"Confirm order for {{user_name}}.\" \"Confirm order for {{ user_name }}.\"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://dedicated-eu-west1.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXX\" \\
    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
    -d \"{\"model\":\"rw-infer/llama-13b-opt-v3\",\"input\":\"$t\",\"max_tokens\":60}\" | jq .
done
```
Kai (oncall): running that now on canary r3d9a vs r4f2b. will post diffs.
SRE Bot: canary run started: canary-id cny-20260311-07; exec nodes: gpu-canary-1, gpu-canary-2.
Kai (oncall): results: r4f2b -> output long unrelated text + token_count 24. r3d9a -> concise confirmation + token_count 17. attaching diffs.
Priya S: confirmed. tokenizer bump changed BPE splitting so extra whitespace inside braces becomes extra tokens and the model invents completions. regression repro is deterministic.
Jordan (support): customer is asking for rollback now. they need a patch or mapping to old rev for Dedicated.
Alex M: I'll open internal change to pin dedicated-671 to rev r3d9a and request infra to route. also file a regression ticket to block r4f2b from being promoted until tokenizer issue resolved.
Priya S: long-term we need a tokenizer-forward-compat test in our model release pipeline to catch these micro-BPE deltas. add to Optimize / model-onboarding checklist.
Kai (oncall): rolling routing override now: mapping applied -> dedicated-671 -> rev r3d9a. verifying traffic.
SRE Bot: routing override applied at 2026-03-11T05:12:42Z. p95 latency reverting.
Jordan (support): customer confirmed behavior restored and will re-enable traffic. they want postmortem and a guarantee this won't recur.
Alex M: filing postmortem and will add a short runbook to detect token-count jumps per-customer after rollouts.
Priya S: will draft technical root cause and mitigation plan.
Jordan (support): thanks team. I'll keep this thread open until postmortem published and customer signoff. :white_check_mark:
